about: The locked Python environments, one per backend (layout python.md section 11; contracts.md 14 question 10). The node reads it to pick an environment from the hardware (M2-16), to show the download size before a sync, and to refuse an AMD card whose gfx target isn't listed. `lock` is the environment's uv.lock, or null while its lock is pending. `expected_download_gib` is the measured cold download of spike 05 (torch and tokenizers only). It leaves out torchvision, numpy and pillow until M2-16 re-measures it (layout python.md 11.2 open point 1; M2-16 owns the installer's size display). The keys `format_version`, `about`, `lock` and `pytorch_build` are beyond contracts.md 15.8's description; the layout's 11.1 note lists them. `env-locks` resolves every lock listed here, and `python/envs/tests/test_env_locks.py` checks that each lock's torchvision matches its torch.

cpu.selection_rule: No supported GPU; every CI runner; the M1 embedded node until M2-16 replaces `just env-cpu`.

cuda13.selection_rule: NVIDIA GPU with driver 580 or newer. The default for NVIDIA.

cuda126.selection_rule: NVIDIA Maxwell, Pascal and Volta GPUs, which cuda13 doesn't support.

rocm.selection_rule: An AMD GPU whose gfx target is listed below. Any other AMD chip gets cpu with the reason; the node never sets HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION (spike 05, flows/platform.md).
